title: Full faithfulness of component inverse image on abelian sheaves
statement: Let T be affine and Gamma(T,top) a w-contractible ring. For the continuous relative profinite test functor [lem-zl-component-relative-profinite-site], the specified sheafPullbackConstruction inverse image componentInverse T from abelian sheaves on Profinite/pi_0(T) to abelian sheaves on T_proet is fully faithful. There is no coefficient, monoidal structure, or realization comparison in this statement.

proof.text: For an extremally disconnected profinite E over π₀(T), the relative universal property realizes T_E with component quotient E. Its stalks and closed points show that it is w-contractible. Clopen refinement splits its finite qcqs covers.

In the inverse-image left Kan extension evaluated at T_E, maps T_E→T_D correspond exactly to E→D over π₀(T). Thus the identity of E is a terminal index after passing to opposite categories. The Kan value is the original abelian sheaf at E. Split-cover evaluation leaves it unchanged under sheafification. The adjunction unit is the identity because it is the Kan coprojection along id_E.

Every profinite test is covered by an extremally disconnected presentation. The unit is therefore locally bijective and an isomorphism of abelian sheaves. The unit-isomorphism criterion proves full faithfulness. Empty tests have zero abelian sections, so the calculation includes the empty scheme.
